comment_regular: Verified QueuedTree vtable QueueModels override (+0x2C). Reads its reference at +0x20, gets the base TESObjectTREE, computes a form-specific LOD multiplier with TESForm_GetLODMult, optionally substitutes value 6 when TESObjectREFR_HasVisibleDistantFlag is true, then attaches a QueuedTreeModel child with the same reference/tree and inherited priority. Probable visible-distant association is supported by Fallout's named getter and identical 0x8000 check; Oblivion helper does not test the base form bit.
